params.body:
Autobedrijf Gielkens has been reporting since 17 September that saving the vehicle sheet bounces with a message about an expired session. Four conversations went looking for the session: `SESSION_LIFETIME` (thirty days), delegation, a shared login, the cookie, `max_input_vars`. No session had ever expired.

What actually happened has been in the log since **16 September 16:32, sixty-two times**, and nobody read it:

```
Carbon\Carbon::rawAddUnit(): Argument #3 ($value) must be of type int|float, string given
VehicleForm::finalizeEdit → OwnStockService
```

A form field arrives as text. Carbon 2 converted it, Carbon 3 refuses it, so `addMonths('6')` throws. Six places in `OwnStockService` handed the value straight over. The save ended in a 500, the Livewire roundtrip broke, and what the dealer was left with was a message about sessions.

It also explains what the five theories could not: why it happened to the operator on *his* cars and never on her own. That branch only runs for an own car with "available within X months" filled in, and almost nobody uses that field. It was never a property of the person or the device; it was a property of the car.

All six places now go through one gate, `OwnStockService::monthsGiven`. Anything not countable is zero months rather than a crash: the classic form requires the term (`required|numeric`), but the Livewire sheet, the partner API and a copied car have no such guarantee, and two of the six were not even behind a `filled()`.

While checking the rest of the code for the same shape, one more site turned up: the vehicle list filtered six times on `subMonths($request['months'])`, straight from the query string. The same crash was waiting there for whoever filtered on "sold in the last X months". Cast along with it. Every other Carbon `add*`/`sub*` in `app/` works on a constant or an already-cast integer, and the Livewire sheet cast it itself on both of its sites.

Why no test caught it is in the neighbouring test: `VehicleSheetWholeNumberTest` posts `'available_within_months' => 0`, an integer, where a browser always sends text. The new test posts the value the way the form does.

Fixes bevinding opslaan-van-een-wagen-met-beschikbaarheid
params.title: Saving a car available in months
